title: 15th-16th century explorers' accounts of Amazon cities

tellings.quote: that you've heard 16th, 15th century explorers seeing these things driving your research, and then you corroborating those stories.

plain: European explorers of the 1400s and 1500s are said to have reported seeing cities in the Amazon rainforest, and later research is said to have backed their stories up. Michels raises this himself while talking with the writer Graham Hancock. He says these explorers' accounts drove Hancock's research and that Hancock then confirmed them, which would mean large lost settlements once stood in the jungle.
